observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa isang sitwasyon, naipapaliwanag ang angkop na city o municipal contact, nasasabi ang unang hakbang sa lokal na pagtiyak at pahintulot, at iniiwasan ang di-awtorisadong pangako o labis na pagbabahagi.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In a scenario, explains the appropriate city or municipal contact, states a first step to verify the local route and consent, and avoids unauthorized promises or excessive disclosure.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Hindi pa natutukoy ang angkop na contact o nangangako at nagbabahagi nang walang pagtiyak.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Cannot yet identify a suitable contact or promises and discloses without checking.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tamang contact, pahintulot, lokal na pagtiyak at minimum na impormasyon nang walang gabay.
levels.kaya_na_en: Appropriate contact, consent, local verification and minimum information without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tamang direksiyon ngunit kailangang ipaalaala ang pahintulot o pagtiyak.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Sound direction but needs a reminder about consent or verification.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Maling contact, walang pagtiyak, o may pangakong hindi saklaw.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Wrong contact, no verification, or a promise beyond the role.
